stories.title: Colts WR Allen arrested on drunk driving charges
stories.summary: Colts wide receiver Keenan Allen was arrested early Sunday morning on drunken driving charges.

stories.title: Sources: Fins trade for Pack's McCord to be QB2
stories.summary: The Dolphins acquired quarterback Kyle McCord in a trade with the Packers on Sunday.

stories.title: Sources: Falcons add Dexter in trade with Bears
stories.summary: The Falcons traded for defensive tackle Gervon Dexter Sr. in a deal with the Bears, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Source: Undrafted rookie lands Bucs' QB2 role
stories.summary: The Buccaneers have decided that Jalon Daniels, an undrafted rookie free agent, will be their backup quarterback to start the season, a source told NFL Network.

stories.title: Ex-TCU S Fields charged over locker room punch
stories.summary: Former TCU safety Jacob Fields is facing an assault charge stemming from his alleged punching of a teammate that led to his dismissal from the squad.
